tools.name: trnch_stats
tools.description: Read live public numbers for the last 24 hours: tokens spotted, tokens in the Heat, tokens kept out as High risk, rugs detected, median detection delay in seconds, number of routers and the bot fee in percent. No key needed.

tools.name: trnch_check
tools.description: Check any Robinhood Chain token before you buy it: is it a rug, a honeypot, a scam or a copycat? Returns { status, category, rugged, dumped }: status kept_out (TIA keeps it out of the Heat and Trnch will not trade it), in_heat, seen or unknown, with a public risk category (SCAM_CONTRACT, LINKED_TO_P

tools.name: trnch_top_24h
tools.description: What performed on Robinhood Chain in the last 24 hours: the best tokens that entered the Trnch Heat (new tokens screened by TIA), with their peak and current multiple since entry, and a link to trade them at the best route. Rugged, dumped and flagged tokens are left out. Past performance, not a pred

tools.name: trnch_register_message
tools.description: Step 1 of 2 to get an API key, no browser. Returns { message }: the exact text your wallet must sign with personal_sign (EIP-191). It is valid for 10 minutes and moves no funds.

tools.name: trnch_register
tools.description: Step 2 of 2: send the message returned in step 1 and its signature; returns { key, prefix, wallet } with status 201. The key is shown once, store it. tools.name: trnch_heat
tools.description: Read the live Heat: heat holds tokens screened by TIA and ranked by Heat score; new holds just-spotted tokens not yet screened (higher risk). Each token is an opaque id with rank, Heat score, price, liquidity, volume, price changes and entry time. Returns nextSince: pass it back as since to get only

tools.name: trnch_quote
tools.description: Quote any pair across six routers (KyberSwap, LI.FI, Uniswap, 0x, SushiSwap, 1inch) without building a transaction. Returns the best amount out, already net of the Trnch fee, and the router. 409 if a token is not tradable through Trnch. Requires an API key (created by wallet signature), sent as Auth

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trnch_register_message, trnch_heat · Private data: trnch_stats, trnch_check, trnch_top_24h, trnch_register_message, trnch_register, trnch_heat, trnch_quote, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm · Public sink: trnch_register, trnch_confirm.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trnch_register_message, trnch_heat · Private data: trnch_stats, trnch_check, trnch_top_24h, trnch_register_message, trnch_register, trnch_heat, trnch_quote, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm · Public sink: trnch_register, trnch_confirm

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
